cases.description: An enumeration alias accepts status strings and rejects unknown strings and integers.
Enumeration aliases with the same local name but distinct expanded names remain distinct.

audit: Reviewed type-alias case descriptions and representative declarations: array/record/union aliases, forward/unresolved/circular references, duplicate names, precedence and package visibility exist. New cases use enumeration membership boundaries and locally rebound QName prefixes with the same local type name. This is a focused audit, not exhaustive absence-of-duplicates certification.
